source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Expenses and Budgeting' (PDF 218), rewritten 2026-10-27 to follow the book paragraph for paragraph.

blocks.text: Expenses (kharche) woh costs hain jo karobar chalate hue aati hain, jaise kiraya, utilities (bijli, gas, pani ke bill), tankhwahein aur raw materials (kachcha maal) ki qeemat. In kharchon ko sambhalne ke liye karobar budget banate hain: budget ek plan hai jo andaza lagata hai ke karobar ke har hisse ke liye kitna paisa chahiye hoga.
Misal: Rawalpindi ki ek bakery ka mahana budget kuch yun ho sakta hai:

items: Ingredients (bakery ka saaman, jaise maida aur cheeni): Rs. 150,000

blocks.text: Budget ka asal kharchon se comparison (muqabla) kar ke bakery dekh sakti hai ke woh zyada kharch (overspending) kar rahi hai ya paisa bacha rahi hai.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Jo chhota karobar aap shuru karna chahte hain us ka budget banayein. Apne kharchon ki list banayein aur kul cost ka andaza lagayein. Agar kharche umeed se zyada ho jayein to aap apna budget kaise badlenge?

blocks.prompt: Class Activity: apni pasand ke chhote karobar ka budget banayein. Agar bakery ke utilities ka bill budget se Rs. 30,000 zyada aa jaye to budget ko theek karne ke do tareeqe bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Ek tareeqa: kisi aur item mein kami karna, maslan ingredients thok mein saste khareedna. Doosra tareeqa: aamdani barhana, maslan qeematein thori badalna ya zyada bechna. Warna kul kharcha Rs. 750,000 se barh kar Rs. 780,000 ho jayega.

items: Budget: har item ke liye andazan kharcha; bakery ka kul Rs. 750,000; asal kharchon se muqabla karein.
